notes.title: Mac and Linux versions now available!
notes.content:
No longer are the Windows folks going to be able to laud it over you, as SkyScrappers is now available for Mac and Linux.

We've tested extensively on both platforms, so hopefully we've nailed any platform specific bugs, but particularly for the plethora of Linux systems that are out there, please let us know through the discussions area if you have any problems with the new versions.

Because you missed out on the launch discount too, we've made sure to time the release in with the Autumn sale so you'll be getting fifteen percent off this week!

James
Ground Shatter
